_comment: IRONSPELLSPLAN — the 'stronger = rarer' precision layer, complementing the mods' own auto-injection (Iron's append_loot + Artifacts roll_loot_table already seed the vanilla chest tables the skyseed explore structures roll). Arcane Essence is the common Iron's Spells crafting mat, so it drops fairly often across the accessible explore structures. Inert without Iron's Spells: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and simply adds nothing when the mod is absent (so this ships safely in the base mod and passes CI).
